name: Nuratau-Kyzylkum Biosphere Reserve
story: The Nuratau-Kyzylkum Biosphere Reserve is located in Uzbekistan. It conserves the landscapes and cultural assets of the Nuratau Mountain Range and the adjacent Kyzylkum Desert.
matters: The reserve is the only place in the world where the endangered Severtsov wild sheep still roam in the wild. It also protects unique flora and fruit trees.
